12.Sub-event_summary: Loss of Orléans on 16 August, First Army weakness, Normandy developments, and southern France invasion on 15 August prompted withdrawal from Bay of Biscay to Dijon under LXIV Corps; 16th Division covered Loire flank, garrisoning crossings except those held by Americans.

External_Maps.External_Map_Description: Map showing the route of Generalleutnant Botho Henning Elster's group from south-western France to surrender on the Loire River in September 1944, relevant to the 83d Division's acceptance of surrender.

12.Sub-event_summary: After capturing Brest on 19 September 1944, VIII Corps transferred control and moved units to new areas; concurrently, the 83d Division accepted the surrender of over 19,000 Germans under Generalmajor Botho H. Elster at the Loire River on 10 September.
